description: Configure which Ecwid apps to scrape from the App Market.

category.description: App market category. Accepts slugs or display names (e.g. 'marketing', 'shipping', 'tools', 'store management', 'store-design', 'analytics', 'accounting', 'dropshipping', 'selling-on-marketplaces', 'customer-support', 'featured').
category.title: Category

includeFreeOnly.description: If true, only return apps marked as totally free.
includeFreeOnly.title: Free Apps Only

maxItems.description: Maximum number of apps to return (1–500).
maxItems.title: Max Items

mode.description: Browse all apps, filter by category, or search by keyword.
mode.title: Scrape Mode

searchQuery.description: Keyword to filter apps by name or description (used when mode is 'search').
searchQuery.title: Search Query

title: Ecwid App Market Scraper Input
